inputs.question: Are dimensions shown for right-of-way improvements such as sidewalks, curbs, ramps, or other ROW-related features on this dimensional control and site plan sheet? Look for dimension lines and measurements for any sidewalk widths, setbacks from ROW, or other ROW improvement dimensions.
inputs.regionHint: Along Collier Street and other ROW frontages
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether dimension annotations (lines and measurements) are present and visible on the drawing for ROW improvements—this is a drawing-element inspection task, not a measurement task.
